name: scene
purpose: A 3D view drawn with three.js. Put body, force, label3d, shot, path, links, points and drift blocks inside it. With bind, it builds one step at a time. With look sky it is a dark, lit view for space, circuits, networks and maps.
binds: number: the step, an int from 1 (optional)
keys: A/D or ←/→ back and next step, 1-9 go to a step, Q/E turn the view, W/S tilt it, R/F zoom in and out; drag to turn; a grip has its own keys

bind.doc: the state key of the step, an int from 1; a part with step n shows from step n

steps.doc: one line for each step, under the view; {path} takes a state value; at most 8 lines of at most 200 characters

label.doc: what the scene shows, above it and for screen readers

height.doc: the height of the view in pixels

scale.doc: the arrow length for a mag of 1; if left out, the largest force is 0.3 of the scene size

floor.doc: the height (y) of the floor; the lowest point of the bodies if left out

ground.doc: false hides the floor and the shadow

blocks.doc: body, force, label3d, shot, path, links, points and drift blocks only

look.doc: toon: flat colour with ink lines on a floor, for objects and forces; sky: a dark, lit view with no floor, for space, circuits, networks and maps

coords.doc: how at, pivot and pts read their three numbers: xyz (y is up); geo: [lon, lat, height] on a flat map, one unit is one degree; globe: [lon, lat, height] on a ball of radius 10
